artworks.title: À Bordeaux (At Bordeaux)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with boats and ships in a busy harbor. The cityscape in the distance features buildings and a cathedral spire. The etching technique captures light, shadow, water reflections, and ship textures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and black. Clouds are lightly sketched in the sky.

artworks.title: Passage de la Marmite, Paris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image displays a narrow alleyway from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Several figures are walking away down the alley, becoming less distinct as they recede. There is no clear horizon as the view is confined within high walls, but a distant view of the sky can be seen through the alley's end. The artwork is detailed with fine etching, emphasizing texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome, dominated by black and white, highlighting contrast and shading. The alley is lined with textured buildings, some with visible laundry hanging. In the distance, building roofs and chimneys are silhouetted against the sky.

artworks.title: Evening Landscape (Return to the Lodgings)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image features an elevated view of a rustic, winding path. The horizon shows a thin line of trees and structures, including a church steeple. The etching is detailed with precise lines, creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia. A figure is walking on the path surrounded by grass. In the distance, there are buildings and trees under a sky with horizontal cloud streaks.

artworks.title: Paris in 1867: View from the Trocadéro
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape seen from a high vantage point. The lower third shows the urban landscape with landmarks and buildings along the horizon. A factory with a smoking chimney is on the left, leading towards the city. Delicate lines define the structures and sky, with hatch marks creating depth. The monochrome palette uses shades of grey and black. The upper portion shows the sky, with lighter strokes in the center darkening towards the edges, indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Paris in 1867: View from the Trocadéro
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape from an elevated point of view overlooking a river. The horizon shows a vast urban landscape with various structures including domed buildings and tall spires. The style resembles an etching with fine linear strokes detailing the architecture and smoke rising from chimneys. The color scheme is monochrome sepia. In the distance, a tall column stands out among the city's architecture. The sky is subtly streaked, creating a subdued atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ruines du Palais Gallien à Bordeaux
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of Palais Gallien in Bordeaux, depicted from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is not visible, as the architectural remains and surrounding foliage fill the composition. The artwork captures a detailed style typical of etching, with fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, brown, and sepia. In the foreground, there are stones and plant life, with a partially visible statue. The focus is the structure itself, with arches and remnants of text, surrounded by an overgrown landscape. In the distance, more parts of the ruin are visible, fading into a background of dense trees.

artworks.title: Dans Mon Jardin à Bordeaux
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a garden from a straight-on perspective, with lush foliage dominating the composition. Tall trees with intricate branches are prominent against the sky. Shrubs and smaller plants fill the scene, surrounding the trees. A winding path leads through the garden. The detailed line work captures the textures of leaves and wood with etching. The color palette is monochromatic with blacks, whites, and grays, emphasizing contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Église Paroissiale de St. Séverin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching of the Eglise Paroissiale de St Severin. The church is shown from a slightly elevated point, displaying its Gothic architecture. The roofline, adorned with pointed arches, spires, and detailed tracery, defines the horizon. The etching features fine lines depicting the intricate details of the church and surrounding foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black lines on a light background highlighting the textural details and shadows. In the foreground, there is a shadowed, enclosed area leading towards the church facade in the distance, framed by thin trees. Two small figures are also included in the image, providing scale to the structure.

artworks.title: Château de Chaumont
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a grand castle, with a view looking up a gently sloping path towards the entrance. The horizon line is high in the image, formed by the castle's roofline and the distant landscape. The castle is depicted with pointed turrets and elaborate battlements on the right side, with trees framing the scene on the left and right. The etching uses fine, intricate lines and cross-hatching for texture on the stone walls and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with a sepia tone. In the foreground, a figure is seated on the path and another couple is walking towards the castle, providing scale to the architecture. The scene conveys a calm and detailed atmosphere, capturing the castle's grandeur within its natural surroundings.

artworks.title: The Banks of the Seine at Bezons
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside view with a slightly elevated perspective. A line of tall trees is on the left, small boats are docked on the right, and a wide river flows towards a distant horizon in the middle. The background features hills and a bridge with arches. The drawing is done in fine, intricate lines with a monochromatic palette of black and white ink on paper, depicting details like texture in clouds, foliage, and water.

artworks.title: Les Bords de la Seine près Argenteuil (The Banks of the Seine by Argenteuil)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The etching shows a riverside scene with a broad view of the landscape. The horizon sits in the upper middle of the image, integrating the waterway with several moored boats. Beyond the riverbank are trees and buildings. The meticulous linework captures textures in vegetation and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing shading and line density. Details include a rugged path and small figures near the water, with distant hills under a sky marked by clouds.

artworks.title: Dans le Port de Bordeaux
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with numerous ship masts creating a forest-like pattern against the sky, as seen from the water's edge. The horizon is lined with tall masts and a silhouette of a building. The style appears to be an etching with fine lines depicting details of waves, clouds, and structures. The color scheme is mostly black and sepia on a light background, giving a vintage look. The foreground shows docks, boats, and human figures for scale, while the background features cloudy sky and structured forms of masts and architecture.

artworks.title: A Cusset (Allier)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a street view scene of a narrow alleyway framed by rustic buildings. The horizon is high, nearly hidden by the rooftops. The structures on the left and right have weathered textures, including sloping roofs and facades. The etching strokes are dark and detailed, depicting depth and shading. The palette is monochromatic, with blacks and grays emphasizing architectural details and a cobblestone path leading to a distant horse. A figure stands on a balcony of the building on the right. Light lines hint at the sky above.

artworks.title: Le Pigeonnier
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree on the left and dense foliage throughout. In the center, a rustic building with a conical roof is partially hidden by trees. The scene is detailed with fine lines, likely from an etching technique, creating a textured appearance in black and white. A reflection on the water's surface captures the scene above, adding complexity. In the distance are more trees and part of the building.

artworks.title: View from the Viaduct of Point du Jour
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting an urban landscape with industrial structures situated beside a river. The composition shows detailed architecture, rolling hills, and a variety of activities. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones, creating depth and texture. Figures, trees, and buildings are intricately depicted in the foreground, leading to a backdrop of hills and a smoking chimney on the horizon.

artworks.title: Bastion 66
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural scene depicting a landscape with a high horizon line showing a distant town or city with buildings and hills. Close by, there are wooden carts, lumber piles, and a structure similar to a barn or outbuilding, with figures present. The middle distance shows more architecture, adding texture. The etching features detailed lines contrasting natural and structured forms. It uses varying shades of black and grey, typical of etchings, focusing on texture and contrast rather than color.

artworks.title: The Porte de Versailles at Pont du Jour
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated perspective, revealing walls and earthworks. Small buildings line the horizon, with a hill and structures in the background. The etching technique displays precise linework and texture details on the terrain, walls, and structures. The monochromatic palette emphasizes ink shades for contrast and depth. Various construction materials and outlines of trenches or canals are visible in the foreground, while urban elements and trees in the distance hint at a mix of natural and human-made environments.

artworks.title: The Effects of Bombardment (Les Effets du bombardement)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a large, dilapidated building in the center. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. In the background, a low horizon with faint outlines of trees and structures. The brushstrokes are detailed and the color palette is primarily black and white. The landscape is sparse with a few distant figures and trees. The ground is uneven and covered with debris.

artworks.title: Le Cavalier, Bastion 63 (The Rider, Bastion 63)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a pathway extending into the distance. The horizon is at the center of the image, with trees and structures lining its length. There are detailed ink lines defining the architecture, trees, and figures. There is a group of people and objects on the path, with larger structures like buildings and trees on both sides. In the distance, the path narrows and is lined by hills and a smaller scattering of people and objects. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink lines to convey depth and form.

artworks.title: Un Tir aux Bastions
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is marked by hills with trees and structures suggesting a settlement in the distance. The scene is rendered with fine, delicate lines varying for texture. The monochromatic color palette is black ink on light beige paper. A road with figures and a horse-drawn cart is depicted, surrounded by trees and buildings.

artworks.title: Avenue de Boulogne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image features an aerial view showing an expansive landscape with a high horizon, a cityscape in the distance with a spire, tall bare trees in the center, a field of tree stumps and logs in the foreground, and figures walking along a pathway. The composition uses fine lines in an etching technique to depict the scene in black against an off-white background.

artworks.title: État Actuel de la Mare d’Auteuil
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with cut logs and a fallen tree in the foreground. There is a person near the fallen tree. The horizon is positioned a third of the way up from the bottom, with a line of trees stretching across the scene. In the distance, there is a slight slope leading up to the horizon. The artwork features fine and intricate brushstrokes or etching lines, capturing the texture of the landscape and the sky. The color palette is mainly shades of gray, highlighting the contrast and details of the etching technique. In the background, there are silhouettes of trees blending into the sky, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Porte de l'Avenue Uhrich
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a perspective from ground level looking across an open space towards distant structures. The horizon aligns with the tops of the buildings in the distance. Various figures are present in the open space, engaged in activities. The drawing is done with delicate lines, resembling etching, showing both architectural and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with black and beige tones on a creamy background. Closest to the viewer, there are discarded items and debris scattered haphazardly. On the right, a person stands near a shadowed gate or fence, observing the scene.

artworks.title: Bastion 49
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a bird's-eye view and a wide expanse. The horizon is placed high in the composition, with faint outlines of distant structures and hills visible. Detailed depictions of trees and structures are seen in the foreground, with fields and roads stretching into the distance. A path lined by trees leads into the scene from the left. The image has a monochromatic color palette, highlighting the black lines of the etching against a pale background.
